title: "Introduction"

:::{important}

This version of the dashboard is retired as of Saturday, October 24, 2026.

Please visit the new dashboard website to view the most recent forecasts at https://insightnet-us.github.io/BDBV-Modeling-Hub-Dashboard/

:::

This is a dashboard for the [BDBV Modeling Hub](https://github.com/InsightNet-US/BDBV-Modeling-Hub) built to collect outbreak size estimates of the Bundibugyo (Ebola) virus outbreak in 2026.

![Predictions of cumulative symptomatic Ebola infections in DRC as of Monday, October 12, 2026. Individual model quantile intervals (50%, 80%, 95%) are shown alongside a smoothed ensemble band. This plot was updated weekly every Thursday.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reichlab/bdbv-dashboard/refs/heads/plot/data/forecast-plot.png){width=100%}

::::{.callout-note}

Changes in predicted outbreak size (particularly decreases) may be the result of different information available at different time points, not changes in actual cumulative infections.

::::
